payload.title: Knowledge run can read accepted References as its only documents
payload.description: reference_documents.py reads only corpora/<key>/extracted/.../extracted_text_raw.md, excludes monitor-delivered References and has no accepted-only mode, and zero documents is a silent success. Add a selection mode where accepted References are documents whatever their monitor, with text from the curation-text payload. Pending and rejected are never documents in this mode. Zero documents fails the run loudly. No run may delete recoverable text because a listing came back empty.
